links.title: EduRank — Cologne University of Applied Sciences rankings

methodology: Overall and subject ranks are EduRank 2026 world positions (lower is better), retained only as bibliometric indicators. Tuition is the non-EU tuition per semester and excludes semester contributions and application fees. Application is the processing cost of one first international application through the stated route: €75 for uni-assist or a required VPD, €100 at FAU under its Winter 2026/27 non-EU rule, and €0 where no separate processing fee was identified for the direct route. Programme suitability is evaluated separately for an international applicant with Tanima's known profile: BSc in CSE and professional software-engineering experience. The app does not know her GPA, detailed module credits, IELTS/TOEFL, German level, GRE or APS status, so it never asserts admission eligibility. Intake chips were reviewed on 14 July 2026: green marks a tracked Summer 2027 opportunity; yellow means a suitable Winter 2027 intake is confirmed but its application period has not started; red means no suitable international English CS-related intake was identified in either Summer or Winter 2027. Application windows, fees and programme rules change by intake; official links are the final authority.
caveats: Ranks are ordinal bibliometric positions, not quality scores; do not average them or treat a fixed rank gap as a fixed quality gap.
A suitable programme means strongly related to CS or engineering and plausibly relevant to Tanima's background, not guaranteed admission.

Tuition and semester contributions are separate. A visible €0 means no tuition was identified under the current policy; semester contributions, application fees and normal living/visa funding still apply.

Application shows the first standalone application cost. uni-assist charges €75 for the first course and €30 for each additional course in the same semester; route reuse and later fee changes can alter the applicant's final total.
EduRank is an independent bibliometric ranking provider, not a German government or university authority.

Every displayed overall and specialization field uses an EduRank 2026 world position. Lancaster's ranks describe the parent university, not the Leipzig branch campus alone; EduRank lists TH Köln as Cologne University of Applied Sciences.
Where a future intake window was not confirmed, the row explicitly says to verify the next published dates instead of projecting an old deadline.

A yellow Winter ’27 chip is not an open-for-applications signal. It means the intake is confirmed but the reviewed application period begins later or has not yet been published; recheck the official portal before applying.
LMU Data Science is marked discontinued and Charité is marked unsuitable so neither is recommended from rank alone.

Map-pin abbreviations were verified on 17 July 2026 against each institution's official site. 14 of 26 are confirmed: KIT, RWTH, FAU, TUM, UHH, UGOE, RUB, HHU and TUD are official acronyms; TU Berlin, TU Dortmund and TU Darmstadt are official short forms; Uni Bonn and Charité are conventional short forms. The remaining universities display their full name on the map pending source-verified abbreviations.
